text:
Maya: Heads-up — planning a production deploy for the qcache optimizer at 2026-03-18T22:00:00Z (~3h). This includes runtime hotspot changes + observability tweaks (new dashboard panels, temporary trace sampling bump, and a short-lived alert threshold change). Who can own smoke checks and telemetry during the window?

Thomas: I can own dashboard updates and metric baselines. Can you list which alerts you want adjusted?

Maya: Thanks. Proposed changes: p99 latency alert loosened from 800ms -> 1200ms for the 30m deployment window, fire only if >1500ms for 5m to avoid noisy pages. Error-rate alert: api_errors >0.5% for 5m. We'll revert thresholds 30m after deploy if stable. Also bump trace sampling for inference service to 25% for 30m to capture regressions.

Lina: I'll run traces and do E2E smoke flows. Which spans to focus on?

Maya: Look at `conv.generate` and `kv.lookup` spans, watch for `rpc.error` tags and long `db.wait` durations. Trace filter suggestion: `service:inference AND span:conv.generate`.

Devon: I'll trigger the deploy pipeline and run synthetic load tests once it's on prod. Need the deploy command and the CI link.

Maya: Deploy command is `infra/deploy --env prod --tag v1.3.4 --component qcache` and CI run: https://ci.redwood.internal/runs/5678 (approve required).

Deploy Bot: Started pipeline run #5678 — waiting for approval from @Maya.

Thomas: Dashboard edits done in the infra dashboard: panels added for `api.p99_latency`, `tokens_per_request`, and `kv.hit_rate`. Quick link: https://observability.redwood/d/infra/qcache-deploy.

Thomas: Snippet of the temporary alert rule I pushed (will revert after window):
```
- alert: ProdApiHighP99DeployWindow
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(api_request_duration_bucket[5m])) by (le)) > 1.2
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: warning
  annotations:
    description: "p99 latency > 1.2s during qcache deploy window"
```

SRE Oncall: I'll manage the alert changes. Two notes: (1) we'll keep the aggregation at p99 over 5m as written; (2) if we see sustained error-rate spikes, I'll open a temporary suppression and page the oncall. I recommend leaving a short runbook link in the alert text.

Maya: Good call. Runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood/internal/qcache-deploy. Include rollback steps and quick sanity checks.

Devon: I'll monitor token cost and throughput. If I see >10% drop in throughput or token cost jumps unexpectedly, I'll trigger rollback.

SRE Oncall: Rollback command for infra team: `scripts/rollback.sh v1.3.3` (infra repo). I'll be online during the window.

Lina: I'll post smoke results here immediately after the deploy with three checks: 1) end-to-end generate success rate, 2) kv lookup latencies, 3) no increase in 5xxs.

Maya: Thanks all — plan: approve CI at T-15, deploy at T, 30m elevated observability, then revert thresholds. If anyone can't make the window, please say now.

Devon: I can be present. +1

Thomas: +1 (I'll keep a browser pinned to the dashboard and traces).

SRE Oncall: +1 (monitoring and rollback ready).

Deploy Bot: Pipeline #5678 approved by Maya, queued to start at 2026-03-18T22:00:00Z.

Maya: Will post a short summary once the smoke checks complete. Appreciate the covers :thumbsup:
